T: One honest cop. No free sandwiches.
D: An honest New York cop blows the whistle on police corruption.
P: Serve the mains when Frank asks to pay for the free roast beef lunch.
S: Toasted bagels with a thick schmear of cream cheese, lox, capers, red onion and dill.
the squad room treat that Frank would pay for, not take free

Bakery yeast doughnuts warmed and dipped in a maple and brown butter glaze, finished with a pinch of flaky salt. Brown 40g butter in a small pan until nutty, about 3 minutes. Whisk in 150g icing sugar, 60ml maple syrup and 1 tbsp milk until smooth and pourable. Warm 8 plain yeast doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip the tops into the glaze, set on a rack for 10 minutes and sprinkle with a few flakes of salt.
the deli lunch Frank would rather pay for
Hot pastrami sliced thin, piled high on rye with deli mustard, a pickle on the side.
M: Frank pays for his own lunch, unlike the rest of the precinct
Steam sliced pastrami until glossy, pile into a long roll with Swiss, coleslaw and Russian dressing (mayo, tomato sauce, horseradish, pickle).
he lives in the Village and cooks for himself
Fry sliced garlic and dried chilli in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes, toss penne through with pasta water, parsley and pecorino.
W: Soft cake-like vanilla cookies baked at 180C for 12 minutes, flat side iced half with vanilla fondant icing, half with chocolate.
K: Village vanilla iced coffee, paid for
Frank's Greenwich Village life, cash on the counter every time

Cold-brewed coffee with vanilla syrup and creamy milk over ice, a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top. The night before, stir 80g coarse ground coffee into 800ml cold water and refrigerate 12 hours, then strain through a paper filter. Simmer 50g sugar with 50ml water and half a tsp vanilla extract for 1 minute and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml coffee, 15ml syrup and 80ml milk to each. Top with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream.

edition.tagline: One honest cop. No free sandwiches.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when Frank asks to pay for the free roast beef lunch.

s.note: Toasted bagels with cream cheese, lox, capers, onion and dill.
s.how: Split and toast 4 bagels. Spread each half thickly with cream cheese, using 200g in total. Top with 200g smoked salmon, 1 tbsp capers, thinly sliced red onion and small sprigs of dill. Cut each half in two to share.

s.note: Hot pastrami piled on rye with mustard and a pickle.
s.how: Steam 500g sliced pastrami in a covered colander over simmering water for 8 minutes until hot and soft. Spread 8 slices rye bread with deli mustard, pile the pastrami high on 4 of them and close. Cut in half and serve with a dill pickle each.

m.note: Steamed pastrami heroes with Swiss, coleslaw and Russian dressing.
m.how: Steam 500g sliced pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and 1 tbsp chopped pickle for Russian dressing. Toss 250g coleslaw mix with half the dressing. Fill 4 long rolls with pastrami, 8 slices Swiss cheese, the slaw and the rest of the dressing.

w.note: Soft vanilla cookies iced half vanilla, half chocolate.
w.how: Beat 115g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 1 egg, 80g sour cream and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 250g plain flour and 1 tsp baking powder. Scoop 12 mounds onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Make a thick icing with 250g icing sugar and hot water, ice half of each flat side, then add 2 tbsp cocoa to the rest and ice the other half.

d.n: Village vanilla iced coffee, paid for
d.note: Cold-brewed coffee with vanilla syrup and creamy milk over ice, a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top.
d.how: The night before, stir 80g coarse ground coffee into 800ml cold water and refrigerate 12 hours, then strain through a paper filter. Simmer 50g sugar with 50ml water and half a tsp vanilla extract for 1 minute and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml coffee, 15ml syrup and 80ml milk to each. Top with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream.
